description: Check robots.txt for many pages of one site at once: takes the URLs from its sitemap (listed in robots.txt, else /sitemap.xml; a sitemap index is followed one level) and reports per bot which URLs robots.txt blocks. Same host only, up to 200 URLs, .gz sitemaps are skipped. Read-only; fetches only robots.txt and the sitemap files, never the pages.

bots.description: Bot tokens to check, or omit for the default 15. Known: GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot, meta-externalagent, Bytespider, Googlebot, Bingbot, Applebot, meta-externalfetcher, DuckAssistBot, Amazonbot, AhrefsBot, SemrushBot, MJ12bot, facebookexternalhit, Slackbot.

limit.description: How many sitemap URLs to check (default 25).

url.description: Public http(s) URL on the site to scan.

name: scan_site
